scene.name: Mix colours
scene.purpose: Choose one to four colours and progressively blend them by stirring.
on_enter: Restore up to four colour IDs, blendMode, mixAmount, swirlAngle and seed.
First colour required; other slots are optional and enabled sequentially.
Stirring in either direction gradually blends all selected colours; Finish blend is optional.
on_exit: Checkpoint recipe colours/mode/mix amount. Stop stir loop, clear tool pointer and settle surface.
scene.persistence: Persist all 1–4 colours, mix scalar, angle, seed and exact undo snapshots. Reset stale fill/reveal/capture on appearance edits.
scene.back_rule: Back 03; Next 05 without a mandatory stir count. Current colour combination remains valid even when no stirring was done.
acceptance: All 15 pairs, 20 triples and 15 four-colour combinations mix and undo correctly.
Either stir direction increases blending; cancellation retains partial progress.
All four slots survive saving, navigation and reload.
implementation_notes: Fifteen pair outputs are defined in the global colour contract; the earlier six blend entries were incomplete for unrestricted two-colour choice.
Opaque foam remains a magical craft presentation; pouring is a virtual process, not an instruction for making real toys.

actions.trigger: Tap swatch; A/B slot determines target
actions.guard: Catalogue palette ID; B is optional; same A/B colour collapses to single mode
actions.command: Set selected slot 0–3; retain up to four distinct IDs; reset mixAmount for new recipe; preserve exact undo.
actions.feedback: Colour deposit ribbon and swatch symbol/check.
actions.interrupt: Cancel deposit tween resolves to current committed colour state.

actions.feedback: Outline A; B no longer outlined.
actions.interrupt: No recipe invalidation merely selecting a slot.

actions.feedback: Outline B; next swatch supplies second colour.
actions.interrupt: Unused empty B does not prevent Next.

actions.command: Remove selected optional colour; compact remaining IDs, reset mixing and preserve undo.

actions.trigger: Drag within bowl or manipulate paddle
actions.guard: Pointer captured on bowl safe surface; no competing blend tween
actions.command: Unwrap polar angle; accumulate signed swirlAngle and absolute-travel mixAmount, reaching 1 after two revolutions. Render all selected colours.
actions.feedback: Soft swirl and bounded audio loop.
actions.interrupt: Pointer cancel stops stir and audio, retaining current state. Ignore near-centre unstable angle.

actions.guard: Ready or current manual stir ended
actions.command: Run two revolutions over 2.4 seconds, progressively blending; second tap stops and persists the partial blend.
actions.feedback: Equivalent visual path, no dexterity requirement.
actions.interrupt: Second tap stops at current state; repeat does not erase prior colour.

actions.command: Optional Finish blend: interpolate to the complete multi-colour target.
actions.state_write: Set blendMode=blend; checkpoint final/interrupted mix scalar; bump revision.
actions.feedback: Swirl narrows into selected pair target.
actions.interrupt: Cancel keeps scalar; no abrupt rest reset.

actions.guard: Undo snapshot exists in this draft session
actions.state_write: Bump recipeRevision; reset dependent completion flags.
actions.feedback: Reverse chip selection, avoid replaying full pour sound.
actions.interrupt: Repeated undo stops at oldest retained snapshot; no credit changes.

actions.guard: At least one valid palette ID
actions.interrupt: No mandatory blending, stirring duration or precise motion.

user_overrides: Keep Finish blend as an optional shortcut
